title: Connectivity explainer stepper + mini-telemetry for private clusters
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Ship a compact, step-based connectivity explainer that lives on Private Console cluster and VPC pages. The component should help operators quickly understand why a tenant is seeing degraded networking (security groups, subnet misconfig, egress quotas), surface a lightweight telemetry strip with recent latency/error spikes, and present one-click mitigation actions (reconnect, restart agent, toggle egress-shape). This ticket covers the high-fidelity prototype, copy/content decisions, and a short interaction spec for the engineering handoff. This is explicitly scoped to the compact 'mini' surface used on the cluster list and a full explainer stepper for the cluster detail page.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma prototype linked and annotated for both list-card 'mini telemetry' and detail-page stepper
Interaction spec (hover states, keyboard flow, ARIA labels) uploaded to Confluence and validated by Accessibility review
Design sign-off from PM (Rohit Patel) and Eng owner (Sana Kapoor) documented as comments
Engineering handoff artifact includes token-level visual spec and example API payloads for telemetry strip
Usability review with 3 internal SREs completed and feedback addressed (recordings attached)
design_notes: Two-surface approach: compact telemetry strip for cluster list (single-line risk + spike sparkline + primary action) and detailed stepper for cluster page (root cause walk-through + confidence score + recommended playbook)
Prefer progressive disclosure: keep list-card small to avoid noise; expand to stepper only on click or when cluster health < 85%
Telemetry strip shows last 15m latency P95, error rate delta vs baseline, and a colored risk pill. Sparkline is low-fi SVG with hover tooltip showing exact values

Stepper frames: 1) Observed symptom (what), 2) Probable cause (why) with evidence links, 3) Recommended mitigations (what-to-do) with impact/cost guidance, 4) Post-mitigation checks and rollback guidance
Cost-awareness: mitigation actions annotated with estimated CPU/GPU or egress cost impact where applicable — pulled from cost model API
Accessibility: all interactive elements reachable by keyboard, color contrast checked, and aria-live used for status changes
Tradeoffs: we intentionally limit root-cause analysis depth to top 3 causes to avoid noisy signals; deeper RCA remains in Ops console
Mobile/responsive: mini-strip collapses to a compact pill on narrow viewports; full stepper is desktop-only (documented rationale)
Telemetry sampling: use aggregated 1m buckets to keep UI responsive; engineering to provide a small sample payload example
Metrics to watch post-launch: click-through to mitigation, mitigation success rate, false-positives where stepper recommends unnecessary restarts

decisions: Adopt two-surface pattern (mini-strip + stepper) to balance signal density and noise
Limit automated RCA to top 3 causes with explicit confidence scores to set expectations
Include cost/impact annotations on all recommended mitigations to help operators choose lower-cost fixes first
Keep full stepper on cluster detail only; mini-strip limited to a 1-line summary to preserve list scannability
